criterion_text: In an approved isolated Kubernetes fixture reusing an existing RWX PVC, deleting and recreating disposable test Pods preserves Server Blob and Agent-specific Cache without rebuilding or re-downloading a valid warm Digest; record before/after Pod UID, PVC/PV identity, exact SHA-256 and transferred bytes. A separate corruption fixture fails closed and re-fetches safely.

verifiers.summary: SC-04 requires an isolated Kubernetes Pod delete/recreate fixture on an existing RWX PVC, but no trusted K8s Case lane exists and kind/PVC provisioning exceeds the 120-second verifier budget; the Issue keeps this criterion Pending instead of claiming live proof
